meta.name: execute-task
meta.description: Complete a selected repository task through automatic repair, verification and authorized delivery. Use only when the user explicitly invokes `/execute-task`, explicitly asks to select and execute one next task/ticket/issue, explicitly supplies a TASK-EXECUTION-PROMPT.md for execution, or clearly requests one task pass from Linear, GitHub Issues, or repository-local Markdown. Do not trigger for generic continuation language such as "continue from here," "resume," or "follow the handoff," nor for ordinary implementation work already scoped by the conversation. If the request explicitly asks for multiple tasks, repeated execution, a loop, or completion of a backlog/project, delegate to execute-task-cycles. Prefer a repository's canonical task execution prompt when one exists; otherwise use the portable workflow.
